name: Onii-chan Chou Suki 99 Jikan Ecchi Shiyo!
original_name: お兄ちゃんチョー好き99時間エッチしよ！
source:
One summer vacation.
The parents will be away from home for a while, leaving the siblings alone.

The older brother loves his younger sisters.

But it is precisely because he is the older brother that he notices that something is strange about them.
Apparently, "I love my older brother so much that I don't know what to do."

With his two younger sisters coming after him, what kind of summer vacation will the older brother spend?

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1121659]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
某个暑假。
父母要离家一段时间，家里只剩兄妹几人。

哥哥很疼爱自己的妹妹们。

也正因为是哥哥，他察觉到她们有些不对劲。
她们似乎“太喜欢哥哥，喜欢得不知道该怎么办了”。

面对两个主动接近自己的妹妹，哥哥会度过一个怎样的暑假？

[摘自[url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1121659]Getchu[/url]]
